findings.evidence: Docstring lines 14-23 vs. `theorem mulVec_signCount` (line 72), `theorem eq_signCount` (line 88), `theorem signCount_solution_pos_iff` (line 107).
findings.fix: Add a sentence naming the restricted-column results: for injective `columns` covering every point of `Z`, `mulVec_signCount` is the moment identity, `eq_signCount` recovers the counts from a left inverse, and `signCount_solution_pos_iff` turns positivity of a solution entry into realizability.
findings.issue: The module docstring describes imported definitions (`signCount`, `signSum`, both from Defs.lean) and names only `signSum_eq_sum_signCount` and `fullInverse_mulVec_signSum`, never mentioning `mulVec_signCount`, `eq_signCount` or `signCount_solution_pos_iff` — three of the file's five public theorems, and the deliverable the PR description calls "correctness of inversion on injective restricted columns".

findings.evidence: Defs.lean:146-148 `tarskiQuery p q = ((p.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => 0 < q.eval x)).card : ℤ) - (p.roots.toFinset.filter (fun x => q.eval x < 0)).card`; Defs.lean:174-176 filters `p.eval x = 0 ∧ 0 < q.eval x`.
findings.fix: Say "the number of distinct roots of `p` at which `q` is positive minus the number at which `q` is negative", matching the unambiguous phrasing already used for `signSum_eq_card_sub_card` (line 107).
findings.issue: "The Tarski query is the positive root count minus the negative root count" reads as counting roots that are positive; the statement filters on the sign of `q` at the roots of `p` (`0 < q.eval x`), not on the sign of `x`. Same ambiguity at line 173, "the difference of the positive and negative zero-set cardinalities".

summary: The prior round's findings are all fixed. Two documentation defects remain: Polynomial.lean's module docstring omits the injective-restricted-column API that is most of the file, and two `tarskiQuery` cardinality docstrings say "positive root count", which reads as roots that are positive rather than roots where `q` is positive.
